policy: Primary sources establish published capabilities, not local gains. Capture content, retrieval time, digest, exact revision, claim, local relevance and falsifier. Community posts are discovery leads only.

sources.use: 32 Xe2 cores, 256 XMX engines, 32 GB, 608 GB/s, 367 dense INT8 TOPS. Distinguish card capability from installed topology and measured rates.
Xe2-HPG per-core/vector/register/SLM/subgroup properties and SYCL query example. Its B580 example is not the B70 SKU.
Register and SLM occupancy constraints; query actual device and compiler register use.
Corrects Intel setup: ./setup.sh --backend sycl. B70 build unchanged versus v0.1.40.2; no new local speed evidence.
RQ-14 installation, supported quants, expert streaming and allocation safety. Follow exact pinned source to verify dispatch.
Discover current Intel backend, then resolve commit before a plan. A mutable branch URL alone is not experiment provenance.
Engine/backend compatibility and installation; verify exact checkpoint quantization and dispatch in the pinned build.
Release notes, model-specific pipeline support and metric API units. Pin release/source and do not guess metric units.
Level Zero/SYCL trace tooling. Verify graph replay coverage; profiler failure does not establish a physical ceiling.
Exact speculative sampling algorithm and assumptions. Map acceptance and verification cost to local counters before proposing speed.
Attention IO accounting; apply only to supported full-attention layers and relevant context shapes.

queries: site:intel.com Arc Pro B70 Xe2 DPAS bandwidth register occupancy
site:github.com/Niko1221/Strata Intel SYCL B70 stream-experts correctness
research_stop: Stop discovery when a primary-source mechanism, local compatibility check, explicit byte/time budget and one falsifying probe exist; or record exactly which premise is unsupported. Never produce an unranked reading backlog.
